items.artBrief: A squat matte-black box on four stub feet with a chrome nozzle at its right end, a gold power lamp and a red carry handle on top; a pale-lilac fog plume rolls out of the nozzle and up to the right in two flat translucent puffs. At 40px it reads as a low black block with a cloud escaping from it — the only appliance in the game that is low, dark and venting, unlike the tall washers, treadmill and arcade cabinet.

A flat band of square light-up tiles in a 5x2 grid glowing cyan, magenta and white, separated by thin bright-white gridlines and edged with a lit white rim — brighter and cooler than the room's own painted chequer. At 40px it reads as a glowing grid; unlike the obsidian's dark polish, the mosaic's tiny tesserae or the marble's veins, its cells are large, self-lit and neon.

Three faceted mirror balls of different sizes hanging on short chains from one chrome ceiling plate, silver-grey chequer facets with a few pink and cyan glint squares and small four-point white sparkles beside them. At 40px it reads as a bunch of silver spheres; every other light in the game is a chandelier, a lamp, a pendant or the laser rig's truss, and none of them is a sphere.

A waist-high frosted-white drum lit magenta from inside, wrapped by three cyan LED rings, with a mirror-tile top disc and a low chrome guard-rail arc behind it. At 40px it reads as a glowing barrel-shaped stage; unlike luxury_goldStatue's figure on a plinth, the cocktail cart's wheels and bottles or the fireplace's hearth, it is a single lit cylinder with nothing standing on it.

A wide black-framed screen split into a 4x3 grid of dark tiles showing a coloured equaliser of cyan, magenta and gold bars of different heights on black, with thin white gridlines between the tiles. At 40px it reads as a black rectangle full of bright vertical bars; unlike the cinema's blank white projector screen or any framed poster, print or painting, it is dark, self-lit and holds no picture.

designNotes: The disco's floor is only free between the two painted speaker stacks (74-324px) and the mirror ball owns the centre of the wall, so the plan is symmetric about the ball: a wall panel hangs directly under each neon bar (x=13 and x=35, below the neon at 24-60px, above the chequer), and a light flanks the ball on each side (x=19 and x=29) where the wall and ceiling boxes never share an x-range. The centre floor under the ball gets only the flat LED dance floor so nothing tall covers the ball or its beams; the built-in DJ booth keeps its own slot under the laser rig (x=19), the low fog machine sits by the left speaker in front of the aurora panel where its plume rises without hiding it, and the go-go podium stands on the obsidian patch under the mirror-ball cluster (x=30), leaving the LED video wall unobstructed at x=35. All standing boxes keep 12-44px clear of each other and every piece draws at 40px or larger.
